jess (docs): node draft:
```js
// prefetch -> generate
const p = await client.prefetch({ model: 'redwood/compact-v1', keys: ['u:123:hist'], hint: {max_tokens:64} });
if (p.hit) {
  const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/compact-v1', prompt: 'Summarize recent msgs', max_tokens: 140 });
}
```
jess (docs): python draft (legacy helper name included):
```py
# new shape
resp = client.prefetch_keys(model='redwood/compact-v1', keys=['u:123:hist'], hint={'max_tokens':64})
if resp.get('hit'):
    out = client.generate(model='redwood/compact-v1', prompt='Summarize recent msgs', max_tokens=140)
```
